verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents choosing a region for a Neon project. The AI Gateway docs name specific AWS regions (aws-us-east-2, aws-eu-central-1), which implies Neon resources are region-bound. Separately, the open-source codebase can be run locally or self-hosted, a workaround that gives full control over where data lives. missing for 10: explicit docs on choosing a project or database region at creation, the list of supported regions for storage, data-residency or compliance guarantees (e.g. EU-only storage), and API/CLI/MCP parameters for setting region.
